newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand dollar closes firmer after quiet day.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand dollar closes firmer after quiet day.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed firmer on Thursday after a short-covering rally pushed it higher towards the end of a quiet session.
"A pretty quiet day, but there was a bit of action towards the close," said a chief bank dealer.
"It looks like a few locals got caught short during the course of the day on the move down to 0.6857 this morning, and a short-covering rally pushed the Kiwi to a high of 0.6885 this afternoon."
The Kiwi closed at US$0.6878/85 and at 68.46 on its Trade-Weighted Index, up from 0.6861/68 and 68.35 at the open.
"It's stalled around that 0.6880/85 level," the chief dealer said, adding that there was still good selling interest from offshore between 0.6885 and 6900.
The Kiwi was seen trading a 0.6860-95 range overnight.
